evidence: Independently re-read specs/behavioral-spec.md (REQ-001..012, full text) and specs/verification-architecture.md (Purity Boundary Map, PROP-001..023, Verification Strategy, Test-Money Safety Rule) this session, plus reviews/spec/iteration-4/output/verdict.json and its FIND-001/002/003.json (the three findings this iteration's commit claims to close). ITERATION-4 FIND-001 (minGasWei undefined): CONFIRMED-CLOSED. behavioral-spec.md:76-87 and :201-205 and verification-architecture.md:18-19 all consistently define minGasWei as the literal constant MIN_GAS_WEI = 1_000_000_000_000_000n (0.001 ETH = 10^15 wei, arithmetic hand-verified), given the exact same single-literal/no-env-override/single-definition treatment as SWAP_MAX_USD, with a stated reasoning paragraph (25-100x margin over typical per-tx Base gas cost). The falsifiability fixture (PROP-005, verification-architecture.md:69; Acceptance Criteria behavioral-spec.md:232-237) uses baseGasBalance=500_000_000_000_000n (exactly half of MIN_GAS_WEI, nonzero) which correctly must return false under the real constant and would wrongly return true under a 0n-default -- hand-verified arithmetically correct and genuinely discriminating at the pure-function level. ITERATION-4 FIND-002 (toleranceBps undefined): CONFIRMED-CLOSED. behavioral-spec.md:364-374 and verification-architecture.md:20-22 consistently define TOLERANCE_BPS=50 (0.5%) with the same literal/no-env-override/single-definition treatment and a stated reasoning paragraph (3-hop IBC route variance sources). The boundary fixture (PROP-013, verification-architecture.md:77; Acceptance Criteria behavioral-spec.md:384-389) uses quotedAmountOutUakt=1_000_000n: I hand-verified 1_000_000n * 9950n / 10000n = 995_000n exactly, so the 'delta=995_000n passes / delta=994_999n fails' boundary pair is arithmetically correct and genuinely discriminates a correctly-tight 50bps tolerance from a looser one, unlike the degenerate zero-delta-only fixture iteration-4 flagged. ITERATION-4 FIND-003 (PROP-005 lacked driver-level cross-call-site identity for requiredBaseUnits): CONFIRMED-CLOSED for requiredBaseUnits specifically. behavioral-spec.md:238-244 and verification-architecture.md:69 both now state, in matching language, that a test must assert the driver's ACTUAL runtime argument to checkSourceFunded's requiredBaseUnits parameter is bit-identical to the SAME value simultaneously passed to SkipApiClient.getRoute()'s amount_in and BaseSigner.signAndBroadcast()'s tx amount, inspecting all three spies' call arguments together -- genuinely mirroring PROP-019's discipline, not merely asserted to. REGRESSION CHECK (all remain sound, independently re-verified against current file text): REQ-012/REQ-006 base-units cap choke point (behavioral-spec.md:483-537, PROP-019/022) -- exact-bigint driver-level call-argument assertions, floor-rounding and wrong-decimals fixtures intact. REQ-005's three-window crash taxonomy (behavioral-spec.md:270-309, PROP-009/020) -- synchronous pre-broadcast 'submitting' record (nonce+leg index) before any broadcast RPC call, call-order assertions intact. REQ-010's destination-address-keyed lock (behavioral-spec.md:431-456, PROP-010) -- still keyed by destination Akash address not route/quote id, dedup-before-price/route-call ordering intact. REQ-009 identity isolation (behavioral-spec.md:410-429, PROP-015/016) intact. Test-Money Safety Rule / PROP-021 (verification-architecture.md:129-144) -- structural static-source-scan over test files intact. NEW GAP FOUND THIS ITERATION (not present in any prior iteration's findings, independently discovered): the driver-level cross-call-site identity discipline that FIND-003 correctly demanded and got for requiredBaseUnits was NOT extended to the other two literal constants pinned in this same commit -- MIN_GAS_WEI and TOLERANCE_BPS. Neither REQ-003's nor REQ-007's Acceptance Criteria require a test asserting the driver's actual runtime minGasWei/toleranceBps argument matches the literal constant (FIND-001, spec_fidelity); neither PROP-005 nor PROP-013 as written contain such a driver-level assertion -- the Verification Strategy's own Tier-2/Tier-1 summaries explicitly scope the driver-level identity treatment to requiredBaseUnits only ('asserts driver-level bit-identity of requiredBaseUnits across all three call sites', verification-architecture.md:110-113) while describing minGasWei/toleranceBps's treatment only as isolated-pure-function-fixture pinning (FIND-002, verification_readiness, critical). A driver bug hardcoding/defaulting a wrong minGasWei or toleranceBps at its own call site would pass every currently-specified PROP in this document while reaching exactly the failure modes REQ-003's and REQ-007's own edge cases explicitly exist to prevent (a partially-fundable swap dying mid-signature; a materially worse-than-quoted fill being reported as success). Both dimensions FAIL until PROP-005 and PROP-013 (and their governing REQ-003/REQ-007 Acceptance Criteria) are extended with the same driver-level call-argument-identity discipline already achieved for requiredBaseUnits.
